indices.description: `tf.Tensor` containing coordinates for the rows and columns to be multiplied. Must have rank > 1.

values.description: `tf.Tensor` containing the values to be scaled and added to the sampled dot product.
constraints: values must be one of tf.Tensor

dense_shape.description: `tf.Tensor` defining the dense shape of the output.

mat1.description: `tf.Tensor` to be multiplied. Must have rank > 1.

mat2.description: `tf.Tensor` to be multiplied. Must have rank > 1.

beta.description: Number to be multiplied with `values`. Defaults to 1.0.

alpha.description: Number to be multiplied with the sampled dot product of `mat1` and `mat2`. Defaults to 1.0.

output_type.description: The output datatype if needed. Defaults to float32.

output.description: A tuple representing the `SparseTensor` components of the result of the operation.
